name: official_play
definition: A PBP row is countable for player statistics only when it is not nullified by a '(no play)' disposition and is not an nflverse play_type=no_play row.
predicate: LOWER(COALESCE(CAST(desc AS VARCHAR), '')) NOT LIKE '%(no play)%' AND NOT (pbp_source_system='nflverse' AND play_type='no_play')
exceptions: Penalty statistics themselves may count an accepted/no-play penalty as a penalty event; this contract governs the underlying football play only.

quorum.adjudication: Either marker is sufficient to exclude; absence of both is required to count.
